questions.question: Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is needed, select 'No article required'.Hiking across _____ Himalayas is going to be difficult.

Select the most appropriate one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the given sentence.He is someone who’s fond of fighting, eagerly seeking out any opportunity to test his skills and prove his mettle.
Select the most appropriate adjectives to fill in the blanks.Despite the __________ weather and the __________ terrain, the team remained __________ throughout the journey.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (harsh ; rugged ; resilient) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.The __________ scientist presented a/an __________ analysis of the data, offering a/an __________ perspective on the experiment's outcomes.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (diligent ; thorough ; novel) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. If there is no article required, select 'No article required'.The conference focused on _____ challenges the United Nations is facing in the 21st century.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.The old mansion had a/an ___ charm, making visitors feel like they’d stepped into another century.

Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.In the heart of a bustling metropolis, nestled amidst towering skyscrapers and ceaseless traffic, existed an unassuming bookstore. Its shelves were laden with volumes of every genre imaginable, from classic literature to contemporary bestsellers. The scent of aged paper and leather-bound tomes permeated the air, creating an ambiance of tranquillity and intellectual pursuit.The bookstore's proprietor, an elderly gentleman with a perpetually warm smile and twinkling eyes, was a veritable encyclopaedia of literary knowledge. He possessed an uncanny ability to recommend the perfect book for any patron, regardless of their age or interests. His passion for literature was contagious, inspiring countless individuals to rediscover the joy of reading.One day, a young woman named Emily wandered into the bookstore, seeking solace from the relentless pace of city life. She was immediately captivated by the store's charm and the proprietor's welcoming demeanour. As she browsed the shelves, she stumbled upon a worn copy of a novel she had long forgotten. Intrigued, she purchased the book and retreated to a quiet corner to begin reading.As Emily delved into the story, she felt a sense of connection to the characters and their struggles. The book transported her to a different world, one where her worries and anxieties seemed to fade away. She was so engrossed in the narrative that she lost track of time, emerging from the bookstore hours later with a renewed sense of purpose and a newfound appreciation for the power of literature.What was the bookstore proprietor's special ability?1095
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Recommending the perfect book) है।
